summary: The five-commit Claude advance contains genuine current-attempt sensor-fixture and dev-proof identity changes alongside reuse of all eight older full-matrix fixture payloads (only attempt metadata added). It does not supply independent physical controls or admit real44 work.

scope.ownership: No adoption; source remains theirs. No native API calls were made by S5; parent states epoch0 assignment/start already done.

findings.finding: Six current sensor fixture identities now match all six dev ATTEMPTS rows.
findings.qualification: 120 deterministic prototype-generated route samples, not120 independently labeled controls, six new independent courses, or an S5 execution.

findings.finding: Full unrounded sensor and contrast matrices cover only four courses on older attempt identities.
findings.qualification: Alex/NorthPark have sensor fixtures, not full matrix fixtures in this pinned directory. Opt-in matrix tests use match2 fixture attempt rather than current dev ATTEMPTS attempt.

findings.finding: All eight existing full-matrix JSON payloads are semantically identical to base after removing newly added top-level attempt.
findings.evidence: Compare old/new parsed documents (four match18 patch pairs, four directly fetched match2 pairs); sourcepins.matrixSemanticComparisons.
findings.qualification: Comparison-only document identity; no matrix recomputation or physical evidence. Generator fixture.py and fixture18.py do not themselves write the added attempt field, so saved metadata has additional custody beyond those generator bodies.

findings.finding: Generator source identity is documentary and locally path-bound, not a hash-pinned prototype-source/attempt manifest.
details: All three read match2.py/match18.py from the fixed /tmp/claude-0/.../scratchpad/after-s4 directory and exec a prefix.
fixture.py and fixture18.py cut before linear_sum_assignment; fixture_sensor.py cuts before the matrix loop.
The sensor generator records attempt=course.COURSES[name][0]; the local imported course mapping and prototype source bytes are not hashed by these inspected generator/proof files.
Random seed20261019;0..2 random interior vertices; final endpoint70% chosen BasketPoint, otherwise random scene coordinate. This is computational equivalence stimulus, not independent negative truth.

findings.finding: Dev proof now guards the current sensor attempt ID but still deliberately skips missing/mismatched fixtures or absent snapshot files.
details: Identity is an attempt string check plus existence of early/s3.pxc.bin, not an attempt-content hash check.
Default path schedules six sensor tests only; full matrices require S7ROUTE_PROVE_MATRIX=1.
Absent attempts/fixtures produce skips, not demonstrated passes. Source inspection establishes configured coverage, not actual pass/skip counts on any machine.

findings.finding: prove() proves agreement with prototype inputs rather than independent physical route correctness.
details: Prototype reconstruction reads the named attempt's serialized cropped raster/Parts and saved S3 refined tees/family model; S4 recovered BasketPoints use prototype offset.
Tee centers/directions/source labels come directly from fixture.holes; they are not independently estimated in prove().
Sensor-only path checks BasketPoints<=1e-9px and sensor pass fraction<=1e-9 with equal station counts; it returns before computed W/start/matrix checks.
Full path adds W/start thresholds1e-9 and matrices/routes1e-6. Recorded match2/match18 matrices are rounded3/2 decimals and compared within half last digit.
prove() itself does not enforce fx.attempt===attempt nor contrast-fixture attempt equality; callers carry that responsibility. Actual four match2/match18 pairs inspected share their older IDs.
A route mismatch is counted only when both JS and Python route vertices are truthy; equality conclusions remain bounded by implemented guards.
Recorded outputs and commit statements are their historical evidence, not our run.

findings.finding: Reported historical outcomes must remain attributed to Claude, not restated as fresh S5 verification.
details: Claude commit claims current-dev sensor6/6 diff0.
Claude routeMatch commit claims72/72 route agreement across four courses and ~11-14minute cold course runs.
Claude latest judge commit claims Alex3/3 route agreement while bends stay unjudged.
These are read commit narratives, not independently inspected execution receipts or S5 reproduced results; no speedup or accuracy claim is independently established here.

reasons: Six courses are explicitly dev courses with reused prototype/system inputs, not independently owned heldout controls.
No independently owned negative/control truth, original full-frame mapping, literal independently fixed heading arms, or exposure-aware accepted protocol is established by these selected files.
Seeded random route vertices are not independently verified physical negatives.
Source/prototype agreement does not establish physical edges/path, width calibration, continuity, antialiasing, ownership, confidence, causality or generalization.
